description: Temporary employment of Sri Lankan Workers in the State of Israel
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2020-02-05 to sign an Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Israel for the temporary employment of Sri Lankan workers in specific labour market sectors in the State of Israel. Accordingly, Implementation Arrangements (Protocols A, B, C, D, E and F) relating to recruitment for jobs in the sectors such as Home-Based Caregiving, Agriculture, Construction, Hotel, Housekeeping and Cleaning Services, Manufacturing and Restaurants have been signed from time to time. Under the said Agreement, the State of Israel has officially expressed its willingness to recruit Sri Lankan workers for jobs in the Commerce and Service Sectors in Israel. Accordingly, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism informed the Cabinet of the measures taken to sign Protocol 'G' under the Agreement already signed between the two parties to enable the employment of Sri Lankan workers in that sector, and the Cabinet granted its concurrence for the measures taken accordingly.
